text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to amend the existing parking regulations on the south side of Melrose Avenue, west of Avenue Road. The proposed parking amendments will extend the length and the operating times of an existing short-term parking area to assist pick-up/drop-off activity for a daycare centre located at 1780 Avenue Road. These amendments will not adversely impact traffic or parking operations on Melrose Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Melrose Avenue, between a point 30 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 55 metres west thereof. 2. Enacted a parking prohibition at all times, on the south side of Melrose Avenue, between Avenue Road and a point 37 metres further west. 3. Amended the existing parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., on the south side of Melrose Avenue, between a point 55 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 39 metres west thereof, to be in effect for a maximum period of 15 minutes from 7:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily, between a point 37 metres west of Avenue Road and a point 51 metres further west.
